instruction: Studio photograph, full shot, high angle. In a minimalist white studio, the dancer in the white outfit (R2) on the left crouches in a low stance with arms extended forward, while the dancer in the black outfit (R1) on the right stands close behind, leaning back with arms extended outward. They pose in a synchronized, defensive-looking contemporary dance stance. Bright, clean studio lighting casts soft, distinct shadows on the white floor, emphasizing the high-contrast black and white palette.
elements: R2 crouches in a low stance with arms extended forward while R1 does not
R1 stands close behind R2 while leaning back with arms extended outward
R2 holds the lower forward-reaching role and R1 holds the upright backward-leaning role
R1 and R2 pose close together in a synchronized defensive-looking contemporary dance stance
minimalist white studio with bright clean lighting and soft shadows on the floor
